project.name: Destiny OS :: Engine :: Bat Tu (chart construction)
project.description:
Bat Tu / Tu Tru chart construction only - Phase 8a.
What this module DOES compute: the four Can Chi pillars under the Tu Binh convention (Lap Xuan year boundary, solar-term month boundary), the Ngu Hanh and Am Duong of every stem and branch, the Tang Can hidden stems, the Thap Than of every stem relative to the Day Master, and integer element counts.
What this module DELIBERATELY does NOT compute, because docs/RESEARCH_BLOCKERS.md has it open: Dung Than / Hy Than / Ky Than (R1), Dai Van luck cycles (R2), and Day Master strength (R3). Those are reported as explicitly blocked sections with their research ids, never approximated. That is also why this engine emits NO signals at all: a polarity for a Bat Tu finding would require exactly the interpretive layer R1/R3 gate.
Framework-free, like the other engines. Depends on destiny-calendar, which is infrastructure rather than an engine, so the ArchUnit rule enginesStayIndependent is unaffected.
